$comment: ADR-284 G6 — the code view's acceptance set (breakdown §7a). Each example: the reference fixture files (react-spectrum 338cf2e1940e395c899e79b7ac09eb0de6b1cea7) and the generated golden file; the states the comparison covers (§7a 비교하는 부분); what it leaves out and why (§7a 제외, plus the additions reported in breakdown §10 Phase 6b). Facts outside the states are listed as 「비교 밖」 by scripts/code-view-equivalence.mjs, never silently dropped. tabs · ripple have no data flow (§7a) and are not listed.
normalizations: N1 useState(<rows>) ≡ useListData({initialItems}) ≡ useAsyncList — one collection state
N2 let {selectedKeys: x, setSelectedKeys: setX} = list ≡ useState<Selection> x — the list's selection
N4 cond ? rows : rows.filter(term) ≡ rows.filter(cond || term) — a skip value
N6 String.prototype.startsWith/includes/endsWith ≡ useFilter's (a case-sensitive one is sensitivity 'variant'); contains(x.join(''), v) on a list ≡ x.some(e => contains(e, v))
N7 typeof x === 'string' ≡ (x != null && x !== '') — the field has a value
N8 a bare item.f term ≡ item.f === true
N9 setRows(rows.filter(r => … !sel.has(r.id))) ≡ list.removeSelectedItems() — which also empties the selection (setSel(new Set()))
N10 setRows(rows.map(r => … ? {...r, f: v} : r)) ≡ for (id of keys) list.update(id, {...list.getItem(id), f: v})
N11 a custom component's props are inlined into its JSX (PlantTable · PlantList · Sidebar · PhotoGrid · Column)
N12 a key list prop of one key selectedKeys={[x]} with onSelectionChange={keys => setX([...keys][0])} — a single selection in a text state
N13 Table's items on TableBody ≡ on Table
